exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.

favorable_scene_effect.qualitative: demands continuous facing and lateral positioning

rules.text: Every attack event fires two full-damage pulses simultaneously, one directly left and one directly right relative to mech facing.
Both pulses use current range and may hit separate targets; a sufficiently large target intersecting both traces may take both hits.
The result has up to 2× raw output but demands continuous facing and lateral positioning.
